payload.posture: Read 2 Kings 25:8–21 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the dated arrival of Nebuzaradan is followed by burning the LORD’s house, royal buildings, and Jerusalem’s great houses. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
